body:
Fix `[BindNever]` (and other `BindingBehaviorAttribute`) on a record type being ignored for its primary-constructor parameters.

For properties, `DefaultBindingMetadataProvider` falls back to the container type's `BindingBehaviorAttribute` when the property has none. Constructor parameters had no equivalent fallback, so a type-level `[BindNever]` on a record was silently ignored.

This adds the same fallback for parameters whose `Member` is a `ConstructorInfo`, using the declaring type. Action method parameters are unchanged, and an attribute directly on the parameter still takes precedence.

Tests added for `[BindNever]` and `[BindRequired]` on a record type, an explicit parameter attribute overriding the type-level one, and an action parameter being unaffected.

Unit tests cover the metadata change. End-to-end binder behavior has not been verified locally.

Fixes #69481
title: Fix BindNever for record primary constructor parameters
